name: QTT AI Credit Ledger
description: Append-only credit movement history — the audit-grade source of truth. QTT Tenant Product Wallet.balance is a derived, atomically-maintained cache of SUM(amount) over this table, not a separate source of truth — see the hardening review section 8 and qtt_platform/ai/services/credit_service.py. No role, including System Manager, can create/edit a row through the Desk UI; every write goes through credit_service.py with ignore_permissions=True.

fields.label: User
fields.description: Null when the credit movement is tenant-pooled rather than attributable to one user (e.g. a subscription grant).

fields.label: Source
fields.options:
purchase
subscription_grant
bonus
consumption
refund
expiry

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: Positive for grants (purchase/subscription_grant/bonus/refund), negative for consumption.

fields.label: Reference
fields.description: Idempotency key for a consumption/refund pair, or a subscription event id for a grant — see credit_service.py.
